bloques.titulo: It places an important action or decision on a specific occasion.
texto: It is typical of formal contexts, such as an opening, a moving or the beginning of a project. For a daily moment, the fact that it is often more natural.
The views of the citizens were taken into account when opening the new library.
The security was reexamined at the start of the plan.

frases.ja: 新しい 図書館 を 開く に あたって、市民 の 意見 を 参考 に しました。
frases.es: Al abrir la nueva biblioteca, se tomaron en cuenta las opiniones de los ciudadanos.
frases.en: When the new library was opened, the views of the citizens were taken into account.

frases.ja: 計画 を 始める に あたって、安全 面 を もう一度 確認 しました。
frases.es: Al iniciar el plan, se volvió a revisar la seguridad.
frases.en: At the start of the plan, the security was re-checked.
